issues.detail: The Hebrew lists 'cursing/swearing falsely' (אָלֹה וְכַחֵשׁ) first, but the Vietnamese renders it as 'nói dối' (lying) and places it second, after 'trộm cắp' (stealing). The Hebrew order is: swearing falsely, lying, murder, stealing, adultery. The Vietnamese order is: stealing, lying, murder, stealing (duplicated), adultery. The first item 'אָלֹה' (cursing/swearing) is omitted, and 'trộm cắp' appears twice (once for גָּנֹב and once as a misplaced rendering of אָלֹה). This changes the list's content and order.
The Hebrew 'אָלֹה' (cursing/swearing an oath) is not represented; the Vietnamese only has 'nói dối' (lying) for 'וְכַחֵשׁ', omitting the distinct concept of swearing/cursing.
